
MyHockeyStats - A Data-Driven Youth Hockey Performance Platform

Design and develop a website for youth hockey players and their parents.
The primary users are youth hockey players and their parents.
Main homepage has a hockey logo, and provide a function to allow to new user to create username and password, or allow the returning user to sign in
After logging into the website, a youth hockey player should be able to:
Create and update their personal profile – full name, birthdate, and location
Allow the user query and view their complete game history across all previous seasons. For example, if user select the 2024–2025 season, the player should be able to see:
The team and club they played for
The total number of games played that season
A list of all games played during the season
Game-by-game performance details, including whether they scored a goal or recorded an assist in each game.
The result shall be allowed to export to a pdf and download

Objective:
Build a web application for youth hockey players and their parents.


User Roles
Youth Hockey Player (primary user)
Parent (can view player data)


Webpage Design

Main homepage has a very nice Youth Ice Hockey Lego
On the main homepage, it provides a function to allow the new user to create an account, or allow the existing user to sign in
After user sign in, four main tabs are provided
Player profile management 
Season and Team information Summary 
Game History Tracking
Dashboard with performance summary


Main Functions
1. Authentication
Secure user registration and login
Each player has a unique account
Parents can view their child’s data (linked account or shared access)


2. Player Profile Management
After logging in, the player can:
Create a profile
Edit/update profile information (name, age, position, team, season, etc.)
Upload a profile photo (optional)

3. Season & Team Information Summary
When user click Season and Team Information Summary tab, a webpage displays the team and Club that this Youth Hockey player played in the all past seasons. 
A query will be sent out query to THF or AHF or AYHL to find the players Season and Team information based on the player’s name and birthyear provided in the player profile created
The information displayed can be exported into pdf document

4. Game History Tracking
When the user click “Game History and Tracking” Tab, user is allowed to search or filter by season. For example, if the user select the season 2024 to 2025, 

the user can view the total points he earns in that specific season
Game-by-game performance details, including whether they scored a goal or recorded an assist in each game.
View a list of all games played
Click into a game to see details:
Game date
Opponent
Final score
Whether the player scored
Whether the player had assists
Individual game stats

5. Optional Enhancements
Dashboard with performance summary
Charts showing goals/assists over time
Export stats as PDF
